regions.label: CartridgeHeader
regions.evidence: iNES header validated by rom.info: magic, mapper 1 and declared PRG/CHR lengths.

regions.label: ChrPatternTiles
regions.evidence: iNES-declared CHR ROM: 8192 NES 2bpp 16-byte pattern tiles, physical graphics backing, never mapped into CPU PRG slots.

regions.label: CpuVectors
regions.evidence: Three little-endian CPU vectors at fixed PRG bank tail; NMI=$F89F, reset=$FFD0, IRQ=$B1D1.

regions.label: TitleStateDispatch
regions.evidence: Inline 22-word little-endian state dispatch; $A073 passes $75 to stack-consuming JMP helper $E333; endpoints bounded by following $A0A4 routine.

regions.label: OpeningStateDispatch
regions.evidence: Inline 9-word dispatch; $A44C passes $75 to $E333; last target $A545; following $A463 handler establishes end.

regions.label: MainModeDispatch
regions.evidence: Inline 36-word mode table read by $E333 after $F98C loads $72. Final entry $FAEB and following $F9D9 handler bound extent.

regions.label: Bank00SceneDescriptor
regions.evidence: Five little-endian scene pointer fields at CPU $8000-$8009, copied into ZP $90-$99 by $A5A7 (physical $1A5B7) and title $A0D2. Repeated seven 16KiB scene-bank headers; claims storage structure, not code/reachability of pointer targets.
